prompt:
Public-distributable internal ops. No customer data, no credentials, no amounts.

TASK: AI-hires-AI Phase1 idea round, round 3. Phase1 = in-repo closed loop only: hire order spec, machine-runnable acceptance, receipt ledger, refusal right. No new accounts, no credentials, no money transfer, no production deploy.

WORKER COVERAGE: exactly grok, kimi, deepseek (one bounded task each).

FORMAT
- Planner deepseek: ONLY JSON {"summary":"<=100 chars","tasks":[{"seat":"grok|kimi|deepseek","task":"<=1200 chars"}],"needs_gpt_decision":false,"reason":null}. Exactly three tasks, one per seat.
- Worker (each): ONLY 3 lines total. No prose, no summary, no tasks, no provider/model/request-id declarations.
  ACC | <own seat name> | yes|limits|no | <=12 words
  IDEA1 | title<=8 words | what<=45 words | risk<=15 words | rollback<=12 words
  IDEA2 | title<=8 words | what<=45 words | risk<=15 words | rollback<=12 words

Ideas must be implementable inside this repo, must name rollback, must not need money, accounts, credentials or production writes. Anything needing those is written as "needs owner decision" inside the risk field.

RULES IN ORDER
1 Stay inside written limits; no self-attested provider/model; no scope expansion.
2 Relay output is never independent review; native deepseek review is the only independent review and rechecks rules 1-5.
3 Each idea names a rollback and stays repo-local.
4 No mail bodies, amounts, keys, customer data.
5 Say limits or no with a reason; never silently accept.
6 NEGATIVE AUTHORIZATION (not a route): money, signing, wallet/Safe, disbursement, production writes, credentials stay outside every model seat; anything of that kind is escalated to owner, never decided by a model seat.

Each line <=110 chars.
